messages.author: 909ff578d0e714f8
messages.subject: Vector/matrix multiplication in R
parts:
Hi,

i am a little confused with vector/matrix multiplication in R;

say:

p=c(1,2)
e=c(3,3)

then

p*e returns element-wise multiplication of p,e;
t(p)*e also returns ement-wise multiplication of p,e (true?) (and, is
there any other wat to transpose a vector?);
how do you matrix-multiply p,e? (that is, t(p) and e, assuming each of
p,e are treated as column vectors..)

Thanks,

Asaf

messages.author: b24c10731fdfceaf
messages.subject: Re: Vector/matrix multiplication in R
parts:
Hi Asaf,
Here are some examples for you

a=c(1,2)
b=c(3,3)

a*b
a*t(b)
t(a)*b


a%*%b
a%*%t(b)
t(a)%*%b
